tasks.prompt: Restore correct Binding.original.line for LF, CRLF and bare CR inputs, including malformed lines. Keep exact original text and existing parsing semantics.
final_command:
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

def rows(text): return [(r.key,r.value,r.original.line,r.error) for r in parse_stream(io.StringIO(text))]
assert rows('BARE\nEMPTY=\n')==[('BARE',None,1,False),('EMPTY','',2,False)]
assert rows('A=#literal\nB= # comment\nC=value # comment\n')==[('A','#literal',1,False),('B','',2,False),('C','value',3,False)]
assert rows("A='café'\nB=東京\n")==[('A','café',1,False),('B','東京',2,False)]
for newline in ('\r','\n','\r\n'):
    values=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(newline.join(('X=1','Y=2','Z=3')))))
    assert [r.original.line for r in values]==[1,2,3]
    assert ''.join(r.original.string for r in values)==newline.join(('X=1','Y=2','Z=3'))
malformed=rows('broken "key\nOK=after\n')
assert malformed[0][3] is True and malformed[-1][:2]==('OK','after')
assert rows('A="line\\nnext"\n')[0][1]=='line\nnext'
assert rows('A="literal\\\\"\n')[0][1]=='literal\\'
